name: nyc-property-resolver
description: NYC property resolution and ECB violation ingestion service

scripts.verify:api-operations: docker compose up -d && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const {readFileSync}=require('node:fs'); const b64=Buffer.from(readFileSync('docker-compose.yml')).toString('base64'); const result=spawnSync('docker', ['compose', 'run', '--rm', '--no-deps', '-e', 'API_OPERATIONS_GATE=1', '-e', 'API_OPERATIONS_GATE_API_URL=http://api:3000', '-e', 'API_OPERATIONS_GATE_COMPOSE_YAML_B64=' + b64, 'worker', 'npm', 'test', '--', '--runInBand', 'tests/integration/api/api-operations-gate.test.ts', 'tests/integration/operations/scheduler-cli-gate.test.ts'], {stdio:'inherit', shell: process.platform === 'win32'}); process.exit(result.status == null ? 1 : result.status);"
